liquidity_policy.atm_contract_selection: per side, the valid-strike contract nearest spot (ties -> lower strike), chosen before and independently of its quote; never a farther strike
liquidity_policy.missing_quote_rule: if no side clears max_atm_spread_pct and any listed side's nearest contract has no usable bid/ask, the outcome is insufficient_data (unverifiable), not illiquid_options
liquidity_policy.quote_freshness_note: not evaluated -- Tradier's chain snapshot carries no per-contract quote timestamp distinct from the whole response's own fetch time
liquidity_policy.rule: chain_contract_count>0 AND total_oi>=min_total_open_interest AND has_usable_greeks AND atm_iv is not None AND (atm_call_spread_pct OR atm_put_spread_pct) <= max_atm_spread_pct
liquidity_policy.underlying_volume_note: never a factor in this policy -- only the options chain's own open interest, Greeks availability, and near-the-money spread
